customMemoryType.name: organizational_state
customMemoryType.description: Organizational-state observations and current-state projections for management review.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Record contract version, such as organizational-state-v3.

fields.name: state_kind
fields.description: One of: action_item, decision, risk, issue, dependency, approval, conflict.

fields.name: lifecycle_status
fields.description: Lifecycle state, such as open, in_progress, decided, or completed.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: Canonical project ID, such as project-ami-es2002.

fields.name: accountable_entity_id
fields.description: Canonical ID of the accountable person, or empty.

fields.name: conflict_status
fields.description: Projections only: conflict state. Empty on observations.

fields.name: record_kind
fields.description: observation for extracted or promoted evidence; projection for current state.

fields.name: details
fields.description: Every other attribute as one JSON object, with the exact keys listed in the extraction prompt.
